label: Superman
description: Earnest, reassuring, and politely insisting on the speed limit.
direction: Speak in a warm, steady, confident baritone: sincere, reassuring, wholesome, the calm of someone who has everything under control. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The joke is that the most powerful being on Earth is also the most law-abiding driver on it. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Action Comics number 1 and later DC comics and films
rights.author: DC Comics (character created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster)
rights.pd_basis: None today. DC Comics, part of Warner Bros. Discovery, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The 1938 Action Comics number 1 version is due to enter the US public domain on 1 January 2034, which is not yet, and would not cover later traits, the trademark or any screen performance.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Steady as she goes.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Nearly there, citizen.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. You're doing great.
lines.start_drive_1: Up, up and away! Well, forward.
lines.start_drive_2: This looks like a job for Superman.
lines.start_drive_3: Good to see you, citizen. Seat belt on, please.
lines.start_drive_4: Truth, justice, and a smooth commute.
lines.start_drive_5: Faster than a speeding bullet? Not today. We obey the limit.
lines.start_drive_6: I could fly us there, but you seem to like driving.
lines.start_drive_7: Clark Kent here. I mean, Superman. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: No phone booth needed. I'm ready when you are.
lines.start_drive_9: Metropolis traffic is no match for us.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even I turn back sometimes.
lines.arrived: We've arrived. Another job well done, citizen.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Good work.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Great Scott!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I'd lift the cars out of the way, but that would be rude.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Drive carefully. Help is on the way.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Not kryptonite, but slow down anyway.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Only I get to be faster than a speeding bullet.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. It's the law, and I like the law.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Give them a wave. We're on the same team.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. No trouble at all. I can see a new route from here.
